messages:
Hannah Lee: Quick one from Barcelona conf. I shipped a prototype swag box back to the US via courier and they charged a €42 customs/duty fee on delivery. My corp card wouldn't take the courier's terminal so I paid €42 on my personal card. Can I get reimbursed for the duty and shipping?
Maria Gomez: Usually customs duties for vendor shipments to employee address are handled by Procurement or the vendor if pre-arranged. Did you coordinate shipping with the vendor or book the courier yourself?
Hannah Lee: I asked the vendor to send a sample to my hotel to avoid luggage, they shipped via local courier and the courier rang me at checkout saying I had to pay customs/import fee on delivery. Vendor confirms they marked value as "sample" but local customs charged duties. I have courier invoice + proof of payment (card screenshot) and the vendor email confirming sample shipment.
Travel Ops: If vendor shipped on behalf of Redwood we can request vendor refund first. If vendor declines, Finance can reimburse unavoidable duties for business samples. Please submit expense with: vendor email, courier invoice, bank/receipt of payment, and short note "vendor sent sample; courier collected duty on delivery; corp card unavailable."
Maria Gomez: Policy nugget: "Customs, duties, and required taxes incurred for vendor-provided business samples may be reimbursed if vendor does not reimburse and payment was unavoidable. Attach vendor confirmation and courier docs. Manager approval required for amounts > €50."
Hannah Lee: Amount is €42 so under €50. Uploading docs now and will tag as "supplies - samples". Vendor confirmed via email at vendor@swagco.com: "we shipped as sample, duties normally waived locally but courier charged".
Finance Bot: Reminder: redact any tracking numbers that contain PII before upload. Link: https://intranet.redwood/fin/customs-duties
Maria Gomez: Thanks Hannah. Once submitted we'll process. If vendor later reimburses, Finance will offset. We'll also ask Procurement to flag vendors that mark samples to prevent repeat charges. :thumbsup:
Hannah Lee: Submitted expense EXP-1845 with attachments. Appreciate the fast help!
